title: Antique Brass Shower Basket 18-3/4-Inch Oval Wall-Mounted, Solid Brass, Concealed Screws, Baskets Collection, Allied Brass
description:

- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for wet environments with solid brass construction and rust proof solid brass wires
- Complements transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories in the Baskets collection
- Choose a look that fits your space with multiple designer finish options available

- Material: Brass (solid brass)

- Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.13 in
